---
name: feature-analysis
description: Analyzes feature requests against the AccessiWeb Engine architecture and identifies scoped implementation requirements.
---

Trace requested behavior through the React/Vite web app, Azure Functions API, shared contracts, engine, persistence, infrastructure, and workflows as applicable. Separate existing behavior from missing requirements, identify security and accessibility implications, and recommend the smallest complete change. Do not implement or claim a feature based only on documentation or model prompts; verify the relevant code paths and tests.
